cohort: 425 pregnant women with pregestational diabetes mellitus (PGDM)
finding: Pregnancy planning in women with PGDM was associated with improved glycemic control throughout pregnancy, but had limited impact on obstetric and perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: While improved glycemic control was associated with a non-significant decrease in fetuses with birth weight over 4000 g and 4500 g, no significant effects were found on other morbidity events, maternal outcomes, or the cesarean section rate.
birth_weight: Birth weight over 4000 g and 4500 g
